summary: Starwood Property Trust filed an 8-K announcing a private offering of $600M unsecured senior notes due 2031. Proceeds will fund eligible green/social projects or redeem/repay $400M of 3.625% Senior Notes due 2026 and for general corporate purposes. The offering is to QIBs under Rule 144A and non-US persons under Reg S. This is a routine debt financing/sustainability bond issuance—not a special situation event like an acquisition, tender, or restructuring.
